framed picture (kitchen) | depicts blue flower, right wall | depicts blue flower, left wall (perspective change) | image content shifts and morphs significantly

findings.description: The image within the framed picture on the right wall shifts and changes shape, appearing to move, as the woman's shadow passes over it.
As the woman walks back toward the kitchen, the framed picture visible through the doorway morphs significantly; the image becomes abstract and unrecognizable, and the frame distorts.
